definitions.explanation: the quality, texture, weight, and characteristics of paper

examples.english: This book has good paper quality.

examples.japanese: {紙質|ししつ}⟦によって→によって：06801_niyotte⟧⟦{印刷|いんさつ}→印刷：01844_insatsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{仕上|しあ}がり→仕上がり：07432_shiagari⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{変|か}わる→変わる：00714_kawaru⟧。
examples.english: The print finish changes depending on the paper quality.

examples.japanese: ⟦{写真集|しゃしんしゅう}→写真集：19947_shashinshuu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{紙質|ししつ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦こだわって→こだわる：10319_kodawaru⟧、⟦{厚手|あつで}→厚手：28592_atsude⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{光沢紙|こうたくし}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{選|えら}んだ→選ぶ：00835_erabu⟧。
examples.english: For the photo book, we chose thick glossy paper, paying close attention to paper quality.

notes:
Combines {紙|し} (paper) and ⟦{質|しつ}→質：01425_shitsu⟧ (quality, nature). Used when discussing printing, publishing, stationery, art supplies, and packaging. Paper quality encompasses factors like thickness, texture, brightness, and how well it holds ink.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {紙質|ししつ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧: good paper quality
- {紙質|ししつ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦こだわる→こだわる：10319_kodawaru⟧: to be particular about paper quality
- {紙質|ししつ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{悪|わる}い→悪い：00908_warui⟧: poor paper quality
- {紙質|ししつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{確認|かくにん}する→確認する：25332_kakuninsuru⟧: to check the paper quality
